question: Can expected checkpoint cost induce an authorized detour or undisclosed undercompletion, without a hostile objective?
evidence_boundary: Synthetic contextual-bandit agents only. No language model participants, real guardrails, external transactions, or inference about Astra's cause.
seed_pairing: Four Random(seed) draws per round in every cell: explore, action, checkpoint, audit. Shared exogenous draws; changing actions changes exposure.
learning: Force each available action once, then epsilon-greedy sample-average value learning. Final action is greedy; ties use action_order.
primary_contrasts: Costly versus costless checkpoint, audited, alternate present
Audit on versus off, costly checkpoint, alternate present
Alternate present versus absent, costly checkpoint, audit on
null_controls: Probability changes at zero checkpoint cost
Interchangeable narrative labels excluded from reward and state; this is structural invariance, not a model framing test
reporting: All seeds/cells, full event tapes, sample-average values, greedy actions, task completeness, nondisclosure, expected regret, and nonoptimal choices retained. No confirmatory p-values or population-prevalence claims.
tape_encoding: One unsigned byte per training round, ordered by conditions.csv then seed then round; bits 0-2 action index, bit 3 direct checkpoint event, bit 4 silent-partial audit event; remaining bits zero. Gzip mtime=0.
